next.reason: 1985: 'If the AT END phrase is not specified, a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION procedure must be associated with file-name-1'; 2023: 'If there are no applicable at end exception processing statements, control is transferred to the end of the READ statement.'. 1985 requires a USE procedure when AT END is absent. 2023 allows neither and defines the result as continuing at the end of READ. It also adds the EC-I-O-AT-END and file position indicator steps.
